title: Khaitan & Co advises on Vedanta demerger into 4 entities
description: Khaitan & Co has advised on the implementation of the composite scheme of arrangement involving the demerger of Vedanta Limited into four companies — Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited, Vedanta Power Limited (formerly Talwandi Sabo Power Limited), Vedanta Oil & Gas Limited (formerly Malco Energy Limited), and Vedanta Iron and Steel Limited.The demerger was structured as a vertical split: for every one share of Vedanta Limited held on the record date of 1 May 2026, shareholders received one
